title: Employee turnover with observational equivalence
accepted_explanation: Employees are leaving because managers communicate poorly.
observations: Turnover increased from 12% to 19% over twelve months.
Exit timing is concentrated in two business units.
participant_claims: Other departing employees mention pay, workload, promotion, and location.
researcher_interpretations: Several mechanisms remain observationally compatible with the available evidence.
assumptions: The most frequently mentioned complaint is the dominant causal mechanism.
